summary_en: Board resolution on July 25, 2026 regarding capital cost awareness and stock price-conscious management. Specific targets and metrics detailed in attached materials.
title_en: Update on Initiatives Toward Realization of Management Conscious of Capital Costs and Stock Price
translation_en_brief: On July 25, 2026, the board of directors of Raccoon Holdings resolved to update the company's approach to realizing management that is conscious of capital costs and stock price performance. The announcement states that the board conducted a reassessment of the company's current status and determined improvement policies, but specific metrics, targets, and timelines are contained in the attached supplementary materials and not disclosed in the main release text provided.
